Tender Notice 2017-18 (Microbiology Project)
Tuesday, 16 May 2017
6283 Hits
The Head of Department of Microbiology, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram invites sealed tenders for the following items under the project "Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance Network Project under ICMR". The tenders in sealed envelope superscribed with name of the item and Department should be submitted in the office of “Dept. of Microbiology, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram, Maharashtra 442102” latest by 05/06/2017 up to 3.00 PM.
Tender forms can be obtained by sending email to ‘
centralstore@mgims.ac.in
’ or can be downloaded from the institute website (www.mgims.ac.in).
The Purchase Committee reserves the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
Microbiology Department (Antimicrobial Resistance Surveillance Network Project under ICMR):
1) Lyophilizer / Freeze Dryer
Tender Document A
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
